description: This file defines a utility enum 'PlatformLabelFormatter' with static methods for parsing platform labels and generating human-readable platform names, primarily used for formatting platform labels in a project related to Apple operating systems.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a raw platform label string into a tuple containing a prefix and an optional version string.

methods.name: pretty
methods.description: Converts a raw platform label string into a user-friendly platform name including version if available.
